About Me

Training that starts from the sales floor

I’m a Training & Development professional with 9+ years of experience in sales enablement across insurance, consumer electronics, FMCG, and service sectors.

Currently, I’m Assistant Manager – Training & Development at Shanta Life Insurance PLC, where I lead onboarding for agency sales teams, design product and refresher training, and build training content, sales scripts, and coaching plans that help field teams perform better.

Before Shanta Life, I worked with MILVIK Bangladesh, OPPO Bangladesh, and VIVO Bangladesh — recruiting and training field and telesales teams, running leadership and soft-skills programs, and coaching low performers through structured improvement plans.

What sets my work apart is how I combine training with technology. I’ve built AI-powered tools — an LMS module, a Lead Management System, Premium and Tax Calculators, and a real-time Sales & Training Dashboard — to make learning and sales tracking simpler and more effective.

I hold a BBA in Human Resource Management from City University, and I’m passionate about building capable, confident sales teams through practical training and data-driven coaching.

Signature Work

Seven tools I’ve designed & built

Alongside classroom and on-the-job training, I design and build practical digital tools for the field force. All seven below are internal tools I created at Shanta Life Insurance PLC — to help agents learn faster, manage their pipeline, and give leaders a clear view of performance. Each card shows real screens from the tool itself; live business figures and individual performance data have been hidden for confidentiality.

01

Performance Dashboard

Sales Command Center

An AI-driven sales & training dashboard built for retail sales team leaders — bringing production, product mix and team contribution into one view, so leaders can analyse performance and track their field force team day to day.

What it does: Performance analysis & field force tracking for team leaders.

02

Lead Management

LeadFlow

An enterprise-level lead management app for the sales team. Agents capture leads, schedule follow-ups and track their pipeline from first contact to conversion — so no lead is left behind in a notebook.

What it does: Lead tracking, follow-ups & conversion pipeline for agents.

03

Learning Management System

Learning Hub

The LMS behind the Shanta Life Field Force Academy — recently rebuilt as a complete course platform. A searchable course catalogue with category filters and designed course covers, courses built from modules and activities, in-lesson quizzes, a downloadable forms library and e-books — with learner progress, Knowledge Credit and certificates tracked as the field force learns, Bangla-first.

What it does: Bangla-first digital learning — courses, quizzes, library & certificates for the field force.

04

Story-Based Training E-Book

Golpe Golpe Shikhi (গল্পে গল্পে শিখি)

A story-based training e-book I created on Shanta Life’s insurance products, so employees learn in a unique, story-driven way — real conversations, simple explanations, red alerts, quizzes and golden rules for every product.

Inside: 11 modules · 20 quiz questions · 32 red alerts.

05

Premium Calculator

PremiumPulse

A premium calculator for field conversations: configure a plan in minutes, combine dual-policy combo packages, and generate a clear quotation and benefit illustration the customer can actually follow.

What it does: Plan configuration & instant benefit illustrations.

06

Tax Tool

Income Tax Rebate Calculator

Works out taxable income, the applicable tax slabs and the maximum possible rebate — so agents can show customers, accurately and on the spot, how a policy supports their tax planning.

What it does: Taxable income, slabs & maximum rebate, instantly.

07

Agent Earnings Tool

Income Calculator

Built for insurance sales agents to plan their earnings: quick income projections, target-income planning, and detailed monthly and quarterly breakdowns of commission, mobility allowance and production bonus — so an agent can set a target and see exactly what it takes to reach it.

What it does: Quick projection · Target income · Monthly & quarterly benefit breakdowns.
